items.text: Copper fell 9.5% and Gold fell 6.9% over the past week, big moves for each. Usually a drag on Integrated Steel, Aluminium & Extrusions and Copper.
The NIFTY 500 fell 0.8% on 18 Nov. Telecommunication was the strongest sector (−0.2%) and Diversified the weakest (−1.4%).

FIIs bought a net ₹5,867 Cr and DIIs sold a net ₹3,160 Cr of Indian shares on 18 Nov. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 57 niches; Lubricants & Specialty Oils, Staffing & HR Services and Electricals, Lighting & Electronics joined today. Heavy delivery buying this week in Large PSU Banks, Small PSU Banks and Watches & Luxury Retail.
